summary: The registrant, Ares Real Estate Income Trust Inc., filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to a prior subscription agreement with an affiliate (Apogee SPV) for an additional $100M purchase of Class B common shares at April 2026 NAV. The total commitment becomes $300M. Terms include a three-year lock-up and subordination in the share redemption program. The filing does not represent a special situation but rather a routine capital raise from an affiliated institutional accredited investor under Section 4(a)(2). No public offering, premium, or deal catalyst is present; no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an ordinary equity issuance with no change of control or corporate action.
